job.description:
I have an existing WordPress real estate website and I’m looking for an experienced WordPress developer to build a custom feature called the Property Match System.

The feature will allow users to create a Property Profile (budget, bedrooms, parking, elevator, etc.) and automatically calculate a personalized Match Score for every property on the website.

This is not AI. It is a custom rule-based scoring system.

A detailed Product Requirements Document (PRD) with the complete specifications will be provided before development begins.

Scope of Work

The project includes:

* Build a Property Profile questionnaire
* Save user preferences
* Create the Match Score algorithm
* Display Match Scores on property listing cards
* Display Match Scores on property detail pages
* Allow users to edit their Property Profile
* Mobile responsive implementation
* Clean, maintainable code

Requirements

* Strong WordPress development experience
* PHP, MySQL, JavaScript
* Experience building custom WordPress plugins
* Experience integrating custom features into existing WordPress websites

Deliverables

* Fully working Property Match System
* Clean, well-organized code
* Responsive on desktop and mobile
* Tested before delivery

To Apply

Please include:

* Examples of similar WordPress projects
* Your estimated timeline
* Your fixed-price quote
* Briefly explain how you would build this feature

Please begin your proposal with the word “Beyta” so I know you read the entire job posting.

pastJobsText.title: WordPress Developer Needed to Implement Figma Redesign on Existing Real Estate Website
pastJobsText.description: Project Overview We have an existing real estate website built on WordPress that is already live. Website:https://beyta.com A designer recently created a new layout and design improvements in Figma, including new sections, updated wording, and layout changes across several pages. Figma design:https://www.figma.com/design/wmax2cWAB1wezvOonh7iGX/Beyta We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer who can implement these design updates on the existing website, both frontend and any backend adjustments needed. The goal is not to rebuild the website, but to apply the new design from Figma to the current WordPress system. Scope of Work • Review the current website and existing WordPress setup• Review the Figma redesign• Implement the updated layout and sections• Update page templates to match the new design• Ensure responsive design (desktop, tablet, mobile)• Maintain existing functionality of the site• Make any necessary backend adjustments if required Requirements We are looking for someone who: • Has strong WordPress development experience• Has experience converting Figma designs into live WordPress websites• Is comfortable working on an existing WordPress codebase• Writes clean, maintainable code• Has good communication and can provide realistic timelines Frontend and Backend Implementation This project requires both frontend and backend implementation. The developer must ensure that the design is not only visually implemented but also fully functional within the WordPress system. This includes ensuring that: • All buttons, links, and interactive elements work correctly • Forms and actions function properly • Dynamic elements connect correctly to the WordPress backend • Existing functionality continues to work correctly The final result should be a fully working website implementation, not only visual styling. While the design implementation is important, maintaining and improving the functionality of the website is one of the most critical aspects of this project. When applying please include: Examples of WordPress websites where you implemented a Figma design A short explanation of how you would approach implementing this redesign Your estimated timeline for completing a project like this Important This is not a basic landing page project.The website already exists and includes many components, so the developer must be comfortable working within an existing WordPress environment.
